# === brave-dev-loop (brave-core) scheduled jobs ===
# Managed by sync-schedules.sh - do not edit manually
# Jobs: projects/brave-core/schedules.sh
SHELL=/bin/bash
PATH=/usr/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin:/snap/bin

# Refresh the PRD cache / backlog before the first run.sh of the day.
# Runs the deterministic sync scripts directly: no agent session, no tokens.
# In prdMode "auto" run.sh refreshes the cache itself too, so this is only a
# head start, not a requirement.
# Gate check runs before git sync to avoid wasted fetches
# Weekdays: 1x/day
45 7 * * 1-5 cd {BOT} && source .envrc && ./scripts/check-has-prd.sh && git fetch origin && git checkout master && git reset --hard origin/master && ./scripts/with-lock.sh add-backlog -- ./scripts/sync-prd.sh >> {BOT}/logs/add-backlog-cron.log 2>&1
# Weekends: once/day (before run.sh)
45 11 * * 0,6 cd {BOT} && source .envrc && ./scripts/check-has-prd.sh && git fetch origin && git checkout master && git reset --hard origin/master && ./scripts/with-lock.sh add-backlog -- ./scripts/sync-prd.sh >> {BOT}/logs/add-backlog-cron.log 2>&1

# Main agent run — skip if no actionable stories
# Gate check runs before git sync to avoid wasted fetches
# Weekdays: 2x/day
10 8 * * 1-5 cd {BOT} && source .envrc && ./scripts/check-has-work.sh && git fetch origin && git checkout master && git reset --hard origin/master && ./scripts/sync-target-repo.sh && ./run.sh 3 >> {BOT}/logs/run-cron.log 2>&1
# Weekends: once/day at 14:10
10 14 * * 0,6 cd {BOT} && source .envrc && ./scripts/check-has-work.sh && git fetch origin && git checkout master && git reset --hard origin/master && ./scripts/sync-target-repo.sh && ./run.sh 3 >> {BOT}/logs/run-cron.log 2>&1

# Review PRs — skip if no recent open PRs
# Gate check runs before git sync to avoid wasted fetches
# Weekdays: 3x/day
0 13,20 * * 1-5 cd {BOT} && source .envrc && ./scripts/check-new-prs.sh && git fetch origin && git checkout master && git reset --hard origin/master && ./scripts/sync-target-repo.sh && ./scripts/with-lock.sh review-prs -- /usr/bin/claude -p '/review-prs 1d open auto reviewer-priority' --allowedTools 'Bash,Read,Glob,Grep,Write,Edit,Task,WebFetch' >> {BOT}/logs/review-prs-cron.log 2>&1
# Weekends: once/day at noon
0 12 * * 0,6 cd {BOT} && source .envrc && ./scripts/check-new-prs.sh && git fetch origin && git checkout master && git reset --hard origin/master && ./scripts/sync-target-repo.sh && ./scripts/with-lock.sh review-prs -- /usr/bin/claude -p '/review-prs 1d open auto reviewer-priority' --allowedTools 'Bash,Read,Glob,Grep,Write,Edit,Task,WebFetch' >> {BOT}/logs/review-prs-cron.log 2>&1

# Review requested from the bot — skip unless someone asked
# Gate check runs before git sync to avoid wasted fetches (96 runs/day, most exit early)
# Every 15 min, on minutes no other job here uses. Shares the review-prs
# lock with the sweep above, so the two never review at once.
3,18,33,48 * * * * cd {BOT} && source .envrc && ./scripts/check-review-requests.sh && git fetch origin && git checkout master && git reset --hard origin/master && ./scripts/sync-target-repo.sh && ./scripts/with-lock.sh review-prs -- ./scripts/review-requested.sh >> {BOT}/logs/review-requested-cron.log 2>&1

# Learnable pattern search — skip if no recent merged PRs
# Gate check runs before git sync to avoid wasted fetches
0 6 * * * cd {BOT} && source .envrc && ./scripts/check-bot-prs.sh && git fetch origin && git checkout master && git reset --hard origin/master && ./scripts/sync-target-repo.sh && ./scripts/with-lock.sh learnable-pattern-search -- /usr/bin/claude -p '/learnable-pattern-search 2d' --allowedTools 'Bash,Read,Glob,Grep,Write,Edit,Task,WebFetch' >> {BOT}/logs/learnable-pattern-search-cron.log 2>&1

# Check Signal messages (every 5 min, offset to avoid git lock contention with other jobs)
# Gate check runs before git sync to avoid wasted fetches (288 runs/day, most exit early)
1,6,11,16,21,26,31,36,41,46,51,56 * * * * cd {BOT} && source .envrc && ./scripts/check-signal-messages.sh && git fetch origin && git checkout master && git reset --hard origin/master && ./scripts/with-lock.sh check-signal -- /usr/bin/claude -p '/check-signal' --allowedTools 'Bash,Read,Glob,Grep,Write,Edit,Task,WebFetch' >> {BOT}/logs/check-signal-cron.log 2>&1

# Update best practices from upstream Chromium docs (monthly, 1st of each month)
15 4 1 * * cd {BOT} && source .envrc && git fetch origin && git checkout master && git reset --hard origin/master && ./scripts/sync-target-repo.sh && ./scripts/with-lock.sh update-best-practices -- /usr/bin/claude -p '/update-best-practices' --allowedTools 'Bash,Read,Glob,Grep,Write,Edit,Task,WebFetch' >> {BOT}/logs/update-best-practices-cron.log 2>&1

# === end brave-dev-loop (brave-core) ===
